definition_en: a single-celled microorganism, some kinds of which cause disease
core_image: 一滴水里挤着的微小单细胞生命
scene: 实验室里培养皿上长出了针尖大的菌落。The scientist examined one bacterium under the microscope.
sceneCN: 这里 bacterium 指「单个细菌」（第 1 个义项：单细胞微生物）；句意：科学家在显微镜下观察一个细菌。

senses.title: A single-celled microorganism
senses.definition: a microscopic single-celled organism without a nucleus
senses.definitionCN: 无细胞核的微小单细胞生物
senses.example: One bacterium can divide every twenty minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 一个细菌每二十分钟就能分裂一次。
senses.why: Science needed a singular for the Greek collective bakterion, little rod.
senses.whyCN: 科学需要为希腊语集合词 bakterion「小杆」配一个单数形式。

senses.title: Disease-causing kind
senses.example: The wound was infected by a bacterium from the soil.
senses.exampleCN: 伤口被土壤中的一种细菌感染。
senses.why: Medicine first met bacteria as enemies, so the harmful sense grew early.
senses.whyCN: 医学最初以敌人身份认识细菌，有害义因而早成。

senses.title: Useful kind
senses.definition: a bacterium useful in digestion, farming, or industry
senses.definitionCN: 在消化、农业或工业中有用的细菌
senses.example: A gut bacterium helps digest the milk.
senses.exampleCN: 一种肠道细菌帮助消化牛奶。
senses.why: Once lenses improved, the helpers outnumbered the harms.
senses.whyCN: 显微镜改良后，人们发现益菌远多于害菌。

senses.title: Agent of decay and cycling
senses.definition: a bacterium that breaks down dead matter and recycles nutrients
senses.definitionCN: 分解死亡物质、循环养分的细菌
senses.example: A soil bacterium turns fallen leaves into plant food.
senses.exampleCN: 土壤细菌把落叶变成植物的养分。
senses.why: The rod-shaped scavengers keep the world's matter moving.
senses.whyCN: 这些杆状「清道夫」让世界物质循环不息。

senses.title: Tool of biotechnology
senses.definition: a bacterium used in laboratories to make medicines or modify genes
senses.definitionCN: 实验室中用于制药或改基因的细菌
senses.example: Insulin is grown inside a bacterium.
senses.exampleCN: 胰岛素可在细菌体内培养生产。
senses.why: What divides fast and takes any gene becomes industry's little factory.
senses.whyCN: 分裂快又能接纳外源基因，便成了工业的小工厂。

senses.title: Collective noun bacteria
senses.definition: the plural used of bacteria in general or a group of them
senses.definitionCN: 泛指细菌或一群细菌的复数形式
senses.example: Bacteria live in every corner of the earth.
senses.exampleCN: 细菌遍布地球每个角落。
senses.why: The Latin plural keeps the scientific collective flavor.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁复数形式保留科学集合语气。

senses.title: Adjective bacterial
senses.definition: relating to or caused by bacteria
senses.definitionCN: 与细菌有关或由细菌引起的
senses.exampleCN: 细菌性肺炎需要抗生素治疗。
senses.why: Adjective form carries the noun into description.
senses.whyCN: 形容词形式把名词带入描写。

senses.title: Figurative spread
senses.definition: something that spreads quickly through a group like bacteria
senses.definitionCN: 如细菌般在群体中迅速扩散的事物
senses.example: Rumor passed through the office like a bacterium.
senses.exampleCN: 谣言如细菌般在办公室传开。
senses.why: Rapid unseen multiplication invites the figurative use.
senses.whyCN: 迅速而不可见的繁殖，引来比喻用法。

intro.en: Bacterium is a modern scientific coinage from Greek bakterion, a little staff or rod, the shape early microscopes saw first.
intro.cn: bacterium 是现代科学造词，出自希腊语 bakterion「小杖、小杆」，即早期显微镜最先看到的杆状形态。

items.en: bakterion was a small staff, a diminutive of baktron, stick.
items.cn: 希腊语 bakterion 指小杖，是 baktron「棍」的指小形式。

items.en: bakteria named the staff of office carried in procession.
items.cn: bakteria 指行进时所持的仪杖。

items.en: Nineteenth-century German science adopted Bakterien for the microbes seen under the lens.
items.cn: 十九世纪德国科学界以 Bakterien 称显微镜下的微生物。

items.en: New Latin gave the singular bacterium with plural bacteria for scientific use.
items.cn: 新拉丁语确立单数 bacterium、复数 bacteria 的科学用法。

items.en: English took both forms; the singular stayed technical while bacteria became everyday.
items.cn: 英语两种形式兼收；单数保持专业色彩，复数进入日常语言。

note.en: Group one holds the rod-root family and look-alikes; group two holds the microbe field.
note.cn: 第一组收「杆」根词族与形近词；第二组收「微生物」义场。

entries.definition: a virus that infects bacteria; same rod root.
entries.definitionCN: 感染细菌的病毒；同用杆状词根。

entries.definition: a staff passed in a relay; from the same French line of staff words.
entries.definitionCN: 接力棒；同出「杖」一系的法语词线。

entries.definition: any microscopic organism, often a bacterium.
entries.definitionCN: 微生物的通称，多指细菌。

entries.definition: smaller than a bacterium and not cellular.
entries.definitionCN: 比细菌更小、非细胞结构。

entries.definition: a disease-carrying microbe in everyday speech.

normalIntro.en: bacterium is Greek bakterion, a little rod: the first bacteria looked like tiny sticks.
normalIntro.cn: bacterium 出自希腊语 bakterion「小杆」：最早的细菌形似小棍。

normal.en: Plural: bacteria, as data for datum.
normal.cn: 复数 bacteria，如 datum 变 data。

normal.en: Adjective: bacterial, as in bacterial infection.
normal.cn: 形容词 bacterial，如细菌感染。

normal.en: Field: bacteriology, the study of bacteria.

abstract.en: See one rod split into two, then a bloom of billions.
abstract.cn: 看一根小杆分裂成两，再化作亿万菌团。

abstract.en: Bacterium is life compressed to a single point of effort.
abstract.cn: bacterium 是把生命压缩成一个努力点。

abstract.en: Picture the world's invisible recycling crew on strike.
abstract.cn: 想象全球看不见的循环工人集体罢工。

examples.en: Each bacterium was stained violet for the slide.
examples.cn: 每个细菌都被染成紫色以便观察。

examples.en: A single resistant bacterium can start a hospital outbreak.
examples.cn: 一个耐药菌就能引发医院疫情。

examples.en: Farmers value every soil bacterium that fixes nitrogen.
examples.cn: 农民珍视每一种固氮的土壤细菌。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「巴克挑利安」——巴克斯挑出利于发酵的小杆，正是细菌

root: 出自希腊语 bakterion「小杖、小杆」（baktron「棍」的指小形式），十九世纪经新拉丁语 bacterium/bacteria 进入科学用语，以杆菌形态命名微生物。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one rod from microscope to industry: the cell itself, its harmful, helpful, and recycling roles, its lab duty, the plural and adjective forms, and the figurative spread.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项随「小杆」从显微镜走到工业：细胞本身、致病、有益、循环、实验工具、复数与形容词形态及比喻扩散。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tiny rod of life, seen only through glass.
core.cn: 核心意象：隔着玻璃才得见的微小生命之杆。

branches.en: The cell as helper: digestion and decay.
The cell as tool: the laboratory factory.
Plural and adjective carry the science into speech.
branches.cn: 复数与形容词把科学带进语言。

branches.en: The single rod and its figurative spread frame the entry.
branches.cn: 单杆与比喻扩散首尾相框。

intro.en: The bacteri- root multiplies through science words; each new suffix is a new discipline.
intro.cn: 词根 bacteri- 在科学词汇中大量繁殖；每个后缀都是一个新学科。

latinIntro.en: New Latin carried the Greek stem into the scientific registers of Europe.
latinIntro.cn: 新拉丁语把希腊词干带入欧洲科学用语。
